details: @reaxuse/core@0.0.1 is a React hooks library presented as a port of the well-known @vueuse/core library. The published artifact is non-functional: it declares a dependency on a sibling package via a file: protocol path ("@reaxuse/shared": "file:../shared") that cannot resolve from the npm registry, so installing it yields a broken package. The package ships a large compiled bundle of React hooks (useFetch, useWebSocket, useStorage, etc.) with no install-time lifecycle hook and no executable payload in this version. The non-resolving file: dependency and the name similarity to a legitimate library are consistent with a placeholder/decoy package shape; no network exfiltration or credential access is present in this version.
